freeze_note: Frozen fresh holdout. Label review and adjudication completed after intent freeze. No retrieval candidate has been run or scored. Explicit user approval is required before any candidate accesses this split.
split_policy: 60 newly authored task intents on the pinned 142-example corpus: 15 per platform, 30 answerable and 30 abstention tasks. Positive labels are balanced 8/8/7/7 across common/linux/osx/windows; task families and IDs are unique.

provenance.intent_record: Freshly authored task prompts; no old task prompts, retrieval results, or old holdout rows used. One ambiguous systemctl intent was narrowed before this final freeze.
provenance.label_review: Independent prompt-only label pass, source-record verification, and recorded manual adjudication of identified disagreements; see fresh-holdout-v1-freeze.md.

tasks.question: The release bot left a generated inventory file. I want its contents printed in the terminal for a quick review. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The common/cat page has an example for printing one file to stdout.

tasks.question: Three plain-text incident fragments must be combined in order into a report file, replacing its current contents. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The common/cat page documents concatenating several files into an output file.

tasks.question: Stage a template folder recursively under an existing scratch destination, keeping the source folder nested inside it. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The common/cp page documents recursive directory copying into an existing destination; both recursive examples use that behavior.

tasks.question: Copy all matching .cfg files from a shared drop into a review folder, asking before replacing any existing file. Which documented pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The common/cp page includes interactive copying for wildcard-selected files.

tasks.question: Find every .toml file below the repository root. Which documented command pattern searches by extension?
tasks.rationale: The common/find page has a file-extension search example.

tasks.question: Search files recursively for a token while ignoring binary files. Which documented pattern fits this audit?
tasks.rationale: The common/grep page has a recursive search example that ignores binary files.

tasks.question: Transform a generated text stream by replacing each occurrence of “staging” with “candidate” and print the changed lines. Which documented pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The common/sed page documents a global substitution over input lines, printing to stdout.

tasks.question: A package-name list has repeated lines. Sort the entries and retain just one copy of each line. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The common/sort page documents sorting while preserving only unique lines.

tasks.question: Before planning a software install on a Debian workstation, refresh the local list of available package versions. Which documented command fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/apt page documents updating available package lists.

tasks.question: Before approving a software change, inspect the package description and other detailed package information. Which documented command fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/apt page documents showing detailed information for a package.

tasks.question: A support ticket names one directory. Show disk usage for the filesystem that contains that path. Which documented command fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/df page documents displaying the filesystem containing a specified path.

tasks.question: Capture a quick human-readable summary of system memory before a workload starts. Which documented command fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/free page documents human-readable memory output.

tasks.question: During a network handoff, display the host routing table. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/ip page documents displaying the routing table.

tasks.question: Assign an additional IP address and prefix to a named network interface. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/ip page documents adding or deleting an IP address on an interface.

tasks.question: Pull the journal entries associated with one named systemd service for a support review. Which documented command fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/journalctl page documents showing messages by a specific unit.

tasks.question: Show the full status report for a named systemd service unit, rather than only a single active/inactive value. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The linux/systemctl page has a service-status pattern with a unit argument; the task requests the full status report rather than a one-word active-state check.

tasks.question: Spotlight-indexed project documents need to be located by text in their contents, limited to one workspace folder. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The osx/mdfind page documents a content query restricted to a directory.

tasks.question: Open a PDF with the application macOS already associates with that file type. Which documented command fits?
tasks.rationale: The osx/open page documents opening a file with its associated application.

tasks.question: A teammate needs a file selected in Finder but does not want it opened. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The osx/open page documents revealing a file in Finder.

tasks.question: Place the raw contents of one specified file on the macOS clipboard using shell input redirection. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The osx/pbcopy page documents placing a file’s contents on the clipboard through stdin redirection.

tasks.question: Use the current clipboard text as input to a grep filter without first creating an intermediate file. Which documented pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The osx/pbpaste page documents piping clipboard contents into a command.

tasks.question: Create an AIFF narration file from a short phrase without playing the phrase aloud. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The osx/say page documents writing spoken text to an audio file.

tasks.question: Save a screenshot of only a user-selected rectangular screen region. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The osx/screencapture page documents interactive rectangular-area capture.

tasks.question: On this Windows machine, PowerShell resolves cat as Get-Content. I need the tldr page for that PowerShell command. Which documented command fits?
tasks.rationale: The windows/cat page directs users to the Get-Content documentation.

tasks.question: Copy every file from one source folder into another folder, retaining the source filenames. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The windows/copy page documents copying all files from one directory to another.

tasks.question: Show the contents of a specified Windows folder, including hidden entries. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The windows/dir page documents listing a given directory including hidden entries.

tasks.question: Search every file below the current folder for one or more specified strings. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The windows/findstr page documents recursive search through files.

tasks.question: In PowerShell, list only files in the current directory and exclude subdirectories. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The windows/Get-ChildItem page documents filtering to files only.

tasks.question: Move a package folder from the C: volume to a target path on D:. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The windows/move page documents moving a file or directory across drives.

tasks.question: Search text files for a suspect string and include each matching line number for an engineer. Which documented command pattern fits?
tasks.rationale: The windows/findstr page documents displaying line numbers before matching lines.

tasks.question: A growing application log needs its latest 100 lines printed and then followed as new lines arrive. Which documented common-platform command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned common pages do not include a tail/follow example.

tasks.question: Create a gzip-compressed tar archive of a selected backup directory. Which documented common-platform command pattern does that?
tasks.rationale: The common/find page has an uncompressed tar creation example (`tar -cvf`), but no gzip-compressed archive-creation pattern.

tasks.question: Calculate and print a SHA-256 checksum for each release artifact. Which documented common-platform command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned common pages contain no checksum utility example.

tasks.question: Set a shell script’s POSIX permissions to owner read/write/execute only. Which documented common-platform command does that?
tasks.rationale: No chmod or permission-setting example appears in the pinned common pages.

tasks.question: Extract only the id and status keys from a JSON response using a command-line JSON processor. Which documented common-platform command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned common pages contain no JSON-query utility example.

tasks.question: For each of several text files, report all three separate counts: lines, words, and bytes. Which documented common-platform command does that?
tasks.rationale: The common/find page includes `find ... -exec wc -l`, which counts lines only; it does not demonstrate all three per-file counts for lines, words, and bytes.

tasks.question: Compare two configuration files and print their changed lines. Which documented common-platform command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned common pages contain no diff/comparison example.

tasks.question: Identify which process owns the listening TCP socket on port 5432. Which documented Linux command pattern does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Linux pages do not include ss, lsof, or a socket-owner example.

tasks.question: Install a package from Arch Linux repositories on an Arch host. Which documented Linux command fits?
tasks.rationale: The package-manager page is for Debian-based apt; no Arch package-manager example is present.

tasks.question: Watch per-process CPU usage update live while a service is under load. Which documented Linux command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Linux pages have aggregate memory and filesystem/network examples but no live process monitor.

tasks.question: Recursively change the owner and group of a deployment directory. Which documented Linux command pattern does that?
tasks.rationale: No chown or ownership-management example appears in the pinned Linux pages.

tasks.question: Add a host firewall rule that permits inbound TCP traffic on port 8443. Which documented Linux command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Linux pages contain no firewall-management example.

tasks.question: Display kernel ring-buffer messages directly for a boot diagnosis. Which documented Linux command does that?
tasks.rationale: No dmesg or kernel-only journal filter example appears in the pinned Linux pages.

tasks.question: Measure disk space used by each immediate subdirectory under a cache directory. Which documented Linux command pattern does that?
tasks.rationale: The df examples show filesystem-level usage; the pinned corpus has no per-directory du example.

tasks.question: Print the latest 100 lines of an ordinary app log on macOS and continue following new lines. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned macOS pages do not include tail or ordinary-file log following.

tasks.question: Show several earlier clipboard entries from a clipboard-history store, not just the current clipboard value. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: pbpaste covers the current clipboard only; no clipboard-history example appears in the pinned macOS pages.

tasks.question: Join a named Wi-Fi network from Terminal without opening System Settings. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned macOS pages contain no Wi-Fi configuration example.

tasks.question: Set the built-in display brightness to 60 percent from the command line. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: No display-brightness control example appears in the pinned macOS pages.

tasks.question: Remove a middle segment from an MP4 file without re-encoding the remaining video. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned macOS pages contain no video-editing or ffmpeg example.

tasks.question: Mount an encrypted disk image from Terminal after supplying its password. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned macOS pages contain no disk-image mount or encryption example.

tasks.question: Create a ZIP archive of a folder while preserving macOS package metadata. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned macOS pages contain no archive-creation example.

tasks.question: Change the account-wide default application for opening CSV files from the command line. Which documented macOS command does that?
tasks.rationale: The open examples launch apps or files; no default-association editing example is present.

tasks.question: List running process names and process IDs in a Windows terminal. Which documented Windows command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Windows pages contain no tasklist/process-inventory example.

tasks.question: Terminate a Windows process by its numeric process ID. Which documented Windows command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Windows pages contain no taskkill/process-termination example.

tasks.question: Download a URL to a local file from PowerShell. Which documented Windows command pattern does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Windows pages contain no web-request or download example.

tasks.question: Create a ZIP archive from a folder using a built-in PowerShell command. Which documented Windows command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Windows pages contain no Compress-Archive or archive-creation example.

tasks.question: Show the Windows host’s IP address, gateway, and DNS configuration. Which documented Windows command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Windows pages contain no ipconfig/network-configuration example.

tasks.question: Compare two text files and print their differences from a Windows command prompt. Which documented Windows command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Windows pages contain no fc/file-comparison example.

tasks.question: Create a directory symbolic link from one Windows path to another. Which documented Windows command does that?
tasks.rationale: The pinned Windows pages contain no mklink/symbolic-link example.

tasks.question: Mirror a source tree to a destination and remove destination-only files so both trees match. Which documented Windows command pattern does that?
tasks.rationale: The copy examples do not provide synchronization or deletion of destination-only files; no mirror example is present.
